contract.palette_world.rule: Pastel cream, peach and warm limestone base for ground, stone and bodies (pale blush and powder-blue renders too); saturated enamel accents (cobalt, royal, sky blue, enamel red, coral, red-orange, oxblood, flamingo, mustard, sunshine, mint, turquoise, teal) on panels, spandrels, bands, awnings, signs, roofs and trim, never a whole building's body; reds and blues are welcome world accents (signals don't own red, amber or violet); blue-teal glass with sky reflections, no curtain walls in the play streets; lagoon water; coral transit; a powder-blue enamel road. Warm brass-gold at street level and on facades: frames, beads, bands, fins and small metal up to about 15 cm; skyline crowns keep gold; never a large gold or brass panel.

contract.concept_prompt.city: Streamline Moderne, Art Deco and Googie. Cream limestone and ivory enamel buildings with seafoam-teal faience bands, chrome sphere finials, banners on lamp posts, planted terraces, cypress and palms, parasol café terraces, pale cream stone paving with seafoam inlay bands, soft lilac-grey asphalt, brushed brass-gold trim lines and bands, coral, peach and mustard accents, enamel red and royal blue accents. Warm afternoon sun, soft shadows, soft blue sky. Clean, prosperous, graceful; people in the city's space-age couture. Cinematic painted concept art with photographic material realism.
concept_prompt.avoid: 1950s period dress: fedoras, trilbies, tea dresses, Americana
